title: Deterministic decision tree average query count
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let the input space $(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)$ be finite, let $\mu$ be a probability distribution on that space, and let $T$ be a decision tree on all $n$ coordinates with input alphabet $\Omega$ and output alphabet $\alpha$. Define its average cost under $\mu$ to be the expected number of coordinates queried by $T$ on an input drawn from $\mu$.
